title: How ChatGPT adoption broadened in early 2026
summary: ChatGPT adoption surged in Q1 2026, with fastest growth among users over 35 and more balanced gender usage, signaling broader mainstream AI adoption.
body: ChatGPT adoption surged in Q1 2026, with fastest growth among users over 35 and more balanced gender usage, signaling broader mainstream AI adoption.
summaryZh: 报告显示2026年第一季度ChatGPT用户群体呈现多元化趋势，尤其在35岁以上人群中增长显著。该数据反映了AI工具在主流市场的普及程度。

aiReview.reasonZh: 属于通用的市场统计数据，缺乏对模型技术本身的实质性分析。
